glosses: financial, temporal-savings scheme; the participants periodically contribute a quota to a communal pot that is given to one member, based on his/her turn amongst all the others

examples.text: Estaba sola el día de San Valentín.
examples.en: She was alone on Valentine's Day.

examples.text: San Pablo es el mayor productor de huevos del país.
examples.en: São Paulo is the biggest producer of eggs in the country.

examples.text: Odio pasar el día de San Valentín solo.
examples.en: I hate being alone on Valentine's Day.
